command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ps=@('CampusNetwork_02','CampusNetwork_03','CampusNetwork_04','CampusNetwork_05','CampusNetwork_06','CampusNetwork_07','CampusNetwork_08','CampusNetwork_09'); `$nodes=@('Core_SW_01','Core_SW_02','PE1','PE2','PE3'); `$ec=[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); foreach(`$p in `$ps){Write-Output ('=== '+`$p+' ==='); foreach(`$n in `$nodes){`$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+`$ec; `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output -split '\r?\n'; `$m=`$o | Where-Object {`$_ -match '^stp enable$|^undo stp enable$|^ip route-static|^ ospf cost|^ isis cost|stp instance [0-9]+ port priority'}; if(`$m){Write-Output (`$n+':'); `$m}}}"
